Only the Qur\'an and the Sunnah that is sahih or hasan, upon the manhaj of the salaf. No duas or practices without evidence.
The base reference is Hisn al-Muslim, plus duas from the Qur\'an. Each dua lists the book and hadith number, or the surah and ayah, which you can see by tapping the source label.
Grades are shown when stated in the takhrij of the source book, along with who graded them. Narrations graded weak by Shaykh al-Albani are not included.
Counts are shown only when stated in the Sunnah. No artificial targets, streaks, badges or worship statistics.
Only clear recitation, with no music, melodic intros or sound effects. The Hisn al-Muslim dhikr and dua audio is recited by Hamad ad-Duraihim, published by IslamHouse.com, and included unaltered.

Duas and dhikr are taken from Hisn al-Muslim by Sa\'id bin Ali al-Qahtani: translation and takhrij from the Indonesian edition, Arabic text from hisnmuslim.com. Narrations graded weak by al-Albani are not included. Duas from the Qur\'an are included as whole ayahs: Arabic text from Tanzil, translation by the Indonesian Ministry of Religious Affairs (Kementerian Agama RI) via QuranEnc.com. Each dua shows its source and takhrij. English translations are shown for the Qur\'anic duas; the Hisn al-Muslim entries show the Indonesian translation until a licensed English translation is added.

The default calculation follows Kemenag RI, including its elevation correction for sunrise and Maghrib, and can be adjusted. Tested against Kemenag\'s official schedule for 16 cities across WIB, WITA and WIT: at most 1 minute apart. Imsak time is not shown.
